item.title: Craft Docs: The digital home where your notes finally work for you
item.description: You put a lot of effort into capturing Christmas gift ideas, project timelines, home renovation plans, health check-ups — you name it. But do your notes actually make you more productive, or make your life easier? For most people, the answer is no. Most people’s notes just sit there.
